MACHINE LEARNING • WORK-BASED PROFESSIONAL PROJECT (LEVEL 2)

Fraud Detection with SMOTE & Ensemble Models

A research-style study on detecting fraud in a highly imbalanced dataset of 144,859 transactions where fraud is only 0.33%. I engineered behavioral and temporal features, balanced the training set with SMOTE (applied to training data only, to avoid leakage), and benchmarked six algorithms. CatBoost came out on top, outperforming the baselines in related studies. Supervised by Dr. Yasser Abdelsattar & Eng. Shimaa Nsr — June 2026.

93.7%Fraud recall
89 / 95Frauds caught
99.67%CatBoost accuracy
✓ Spearman Correlation & Feature Engineering✓ SMOTE (115,507 per class)✓ 6-Model Benchmark✓ Confusion Matrix & F1 Analysis

AI vs Hackers: The Cyber Battle of the Future

A presentation prepared for a Communication & Presentation Skills training.
